patterns.failure_analysis: FailureAnalyzer in analysis/failure_analyzer.py uses heuristics and optional Claude SDK for root cause analysis. Returns structured failure data.
patterns.pattern_storage: PatternStore in integrations/graphiti/pattern_store.py manages pattern storage and retrieval with confidence tracking using Graphiti memory.
patterns.recovery_system: RecoveryManager in services/recovery.py provides automatic rollback, circular fix detection, and attempt history tracking.
patterns.cli_commands: CLI commands in cli/ use argparse subcommands pattern. Pattern commands in cli/pattern_commands.py use get_graphiti_memory() helper.
patterns.graphiti_integration: Graphiti memory accessed via memory.graphiti_helpers.get_graphiti_memory(). Uses run_async() for async operations.
patterns.qa_metrics: RecoveryMetrics in qa/recovery_metrics.py tracks recovery success rates and metrics for QA loop.

failure_analysis.details: FailureAnalyzer extracts root causes from build failures using heuristics and optional Claude SDK. Returns structured failure data with type, root_cause, suggested_fix.

pattern_storage.details: PatternStore manages pattern storage and retrieval with confidence tracking. Uses Graphiti memory for cross-session learning.

recovery_system.details: RecoveryManager provides automatic rollback, circular fix detection, and attempt history tracking. Has FailureType enum and retry strategies.

cli_pattern_commands.details: CLI commands for listing learned patterns. Uses get_graphiti_memory() helper and pattern categorization.

graphiti_helpers.description: Found Graphiti memory helpers in apps/backend/memory/graphiti_helpers.py
graphiti_helpers.details: get_graphiti_memory() factory function. run_async() wrapper for async operations. File-based pattern storage as fallback.
